reviewed_source_state: Reviewed v3 MAC with scrypt-bound verifier, verifierEnc on the wire by default when a pepper is present (OPENSESAME_FEDERATED_PENDING_SEAL_VERIFIER default on; explicit false is rollout-off), and leg-binding for seal/unseal. 2026-11-23 review (#2899, squash 760292b7): federated.ts moved FederatedUpstream, federatedUpstreams, matchUpstreamHint and isTrustedUpstream into the new federated-upstreams.ts and re-exports them; it also re-exports four more existing upstream-logout.ts functions. Compared with the reviewed bytes (760292b7^): matchUpstreamHint, isTrustedUpstream, federatedUpstreams, issuerHost and the shoo.dev branch of describeUpstream are byte-identical. The only behaviour change is that describeUpstream's inline isLoopback became issuer-loopback.ts isLoopbackIssuer, which reads URL.hostname instead of splitting URL.host on ':', so an IPv6 loopback issuer such as http://[::1]:9090 is now labelled id 'mock' (previously its host) on the allowlist display. isTrustedUpstream stays exact membership in trustedUpstreamIssuers. No production caller of these four names exists (only tests), and none is on the pending-cookie, legacy-provenance, current-trust or verifier-binding paths that FED-I1-I4 model, so the model needs no change. federated-upstreams.ts joins the covered sources (here, check-drift.mjs, proof-registry.json, proof-requirements.json and the pinned suite minimum) and federated.ts is re-pinned; issuer-loopback.ts is a display/browser-capability helper shared with the uncovered registry.ts and stays outside this suite. 2026-11-23 review (#2899, squash 760292b7) of routes/interactions.ts against its reviewed bytes (73e48026): the only change imports joinRefusalStatus from organization-membership.ts and returns its status when the SSO just-in-time join is refused, 503 for membership_withdrawing and 403 otherwise (previously always 403). The refusal still returns before finishLoginInteraction, after the unchanged pending-issuer, trust-source, organization-ID and configured-issuer checks, so no success path is added and FED-I3's ordering of trust checks before account or organization effects is preserved; the status code is not modeled. 2026-11-23 review (v4 pending cookie, unauthenticated scrypt denial of service): federated-pending.ts replaces the v3 scrypt-bound MAC with a v4 HMAC-SHA-256 over the exact encoded payload under a v4-only derived key, checked (after a 4096-byte length cap and base64url shape check) before the payload is parsed, the verifier unsealed or any key derived. scrypt is removed from the codec. The signed wire shape requires verifierEnc and is strict, so plaintext and mixed verifier shapes are refused even under a valid tag. v3 (wire, dual, payload) and pre-v3 legacy tags are no longer verified and their sign-ins restart (cookie max-age 600 s). encodePending and decodePending take an optional PendingCookieKeys seam used only by tests to count derivations. routes/interactions.ts (and the uncovered interactions-byo.ts and config.ts) drop the sealVerifierOnWire option and the OPENSESAME_FEDERATED_PENDING_SEAL_VERIFIER flag; no other route behaviour changes, and the trust, issuer, organization and ordering checks that FED-I3 relies on are byte-identical. Model impact: FED-I1 still maps (the verifier binding is the sealed field inside the authenticated payload); FED-I2 is refined conservatively (every legacy tag refused, so legacy_static_signed_provider_accepted no longer describes the implementation); FED-I4 is restated and unproved, since wire_encoding_does_not_change_mac_binding modelled the retired v3 binding. Lean was not available, so the theorems were not re-run; correspondence and security tests were run against vectors from a Python mirror of PendingIntegrity.lean main, not Lean output. 2026-11-24 (Lean 4.24.0 installed): PendingIntegrity.lean restated for v4 against the same reviewed bytes. FED-I1 binds the strict sealed payload including verifierEnc; FED-I2 refuses every legacy cookie (acceptsLegacy is the v4 decoder on a plaintext-verifier payload), with exact correspondence; FED-I4 models decodeSigned as decodeTrace (mac before parse, deriveKey and unseal) with 160 v4 correspondence cases checking acceptance and derivation counts. verify:oauth-formal, negative-controls.py and hosted-flow-negative-controls.py passed; source hashes unchanged.
